description: This file contains utility functions for enriching documents with normalized project IDs and updated timestamps. It provides functions to normalize project identifiers from various input formats, parse dates from different representations, compute the most relevant update timestamp from document fields, and enrich deployment-like documents with these normalized and computed values.

methods.name: normalizeProjectId
methods.description: Normalizes various forms of projectId fields to a lowercase string id, handling strings, numbers, and nested object fields.

methods.name: toValidDate
methods.description: Parses a value into a valid Date object if possible, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: computeUpdatedAt
methods.description: Computes the most relevant updated timestamp from a document's fields or its _id.

methods.name: enrichDeployment
methods.description: Enriches a deployment-like document with normalized projectId and updatedAt timestamp.
